# NLS demo catalogs (Pig Latin, Esperanto, Klingon) Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add `en@piglatin`, `eo`, and `tlh` message catalogs for the postgres, psql, and libpq domains on a local branch, and show them working at run time.

**Architecture:** Fresh `.pot` templates are generated by autoconf `init-po`. Pig Latin is produced by a deterministic generator.  Esperanto and Klingon are translated in 250-entry JSON chunks by parallel subagents using a shared glossary, validated per chunk and per catalog with `msgfmt -c`, and merged into `.po` files.  Meson picks the catalogs up from `LINGUAS`; languages are selected at run time with `LANGUAGE`.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.12 + polib (venv in `results/nls-demo/.venv`), GNU gettext (`msgfmt`), meson/ninja, autoconf (templates only).

Spec: `results/nls-demo/spec.md`

## Global Constraints

- Language codes: `en@piglatin`, `eo`, `tlh`.  Catalogs: postgres, psql, libpq only.
- In-tree changes are limited to `src/backend/po`, `src/bin/psql/po`, `src/interfaces/libpq/po`: new `<lang>.po` files and `LINGUAS` entries.
- Tools, templates, work files stay in `/home/andrew/pgl/pg_head/results/nls-demo/` (never committed).
- All `.po` files UTF-8, `Plural-Forms: nplurals=2; plural=(n != 1);`, must pass `msgfmt -c`.
- Pig Latin stopwords (left in English): `a an the is are was be been of to in on at by for as or and it its if no not`.
- Klingon in Okrand Latin orthography, not pIqaD.
- Validation on a cassert build (`-Dcassert=true`), meson.
- Commits: author Andrew Dunstan <andrew@dunslane.net> (git config already matches); no `Author:`/`Reviewed-by:` trailers (sole author).  Committer register per `~/.claude/writing-style.md`, two spaces after periods.
- Local branch only; nothing pushed or sent upstream.
